items.summary_md: Update: Adds story quests, Rito postbox letters, Mod SDK v2 and a fallback for older Intel/AMD GPUs; runs natively on Windows, macOS, Linux and Android with your own game files.
Update: Adds Mirror Mode, 8 languages and Vulkan speedups and fixes the 30 FPS outdoor lock; still a beta with known issues.
items.details_md:
### What Beta 4 is
[LAS Recomp Beta 4](https://github.com/peiikai/LASRecomp/releases/tag/beta_4) shipped Oct 14 at 8:07 PM AZ for Windows, macOS, and Linux (x86-64 and ARM AppImages). It's a native static recompilation of the 2019 Switch *Link's Awakening*, not an emulator. The [README](https://github.com/peiikai/LASRecomp#readme) says the project was made "almost exclusively with AI."

### What's new and fixed
- **New options:** Mirror Mode and 8 languages (JP/EN/ES/FR/DE/IT/NL/RU). Korean and Chinese are coming later.
- **Randomizer:** overworld mini-bosses, underwater checks, and a "Bomb Bag" item.
- **Performance:** Vulkan speedups, a fix for the 30 FPS outdoor lock, and no more slow motion below 60 FPS on Windows/Linux. macOS gets that fix next patch.
- **Fixes:** Digsanity, Dungeon Room Shuffle maps, the Walrus softlock, Mysterious Woods mist, white Link on some M1 Macs, and the macOS keystroke prompt.

### Requirements
You need your own **v1.0.0** game files. Beta 4's setup now asks for the [folder holding exefs/romfs](https://github.com/peiikai/LASRecomp/commit/ff09ff131c9e22531302b133f78d5f6ef585fc7e). Beta 3 asked for the .nsp and keys instead ([#31](https://github.com/peiikai/LASRecomp/issues/31)). On first launch the game code is recompiled locally on your PC. Windows needs AVX2 and Vulkan 1.3.

### Known issues
**From the release notes:**
- "Bomb Refills are shown as Bomb Bag incorrectly", but seeds are still playable.

**[README](https://github.com/peiikai/LASRecomp#known-issues)** (the Mysterious Woods entry is still listed even though Beta 4 says it's fixed):
- Some lighting effects show horizontal or vertical lines in dungeons, caves, and houses.
- Controller doesn't work on the start screen.
- Shadow bugs in big dungeon rooms at ultrawide.
- Black boxes sometimes appear in dungeon rooms.
- Checking the dresser in BowWow's mom's room crashes the game.
- Clicking Title Screen in the custom settings crashes.

**Open GitHub issues:**
- [#19](https://github.com/peiikai/LASRecomp/issues/19): null-pointer crash (SIGSEGV), still **open**. It reproduced twice on Beta 4 while walking the overworld, once after 7.7 minutes.
- [#16](https://github.com/peiikai/LASRecomp/issues/16): still **open**. The original reporter says Beta 4 fixed the 30 FPS drop. Another tester still saw about a third of a session locked at 30 FPS on the overworld (RX 6800 XT), but no stalls or slow motion.
- [#8](https://github.com/peiikai/LASRecomp/issues/8): crashes on Intel UHD 630, still open.
- [#33](https://github.com/peiikai/LASRecomp/issues/33): error when minimizing the window (Windows).
- [#31](https://github.com/peiikai/LASRecomp/issues/31): Beta 3 users who upgraded can't get through setup.
- [#32](https://github.com/peiikai/LASRecomp/issues/32): letter spacing in the Russian text.
- [#20](https://github.com/peiikai/LASRecomp/issues/20): you can't steal from the shop.

### Stable yet?
No. The README still says "crashes could occur," and the one reproducible gameplay crash (#19) is unfixed. Beta 4 is a big improvement in performance, but it isn't the crash-free release you're waiting for.
